title: 第35章 我怀疑你的兵，手脚不干净！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “那边什么情况？”“不知道啊？”“我好像听到，有人在喊抓小偷？”“听错了吧，我听着怎么像挖水沟？”周凯东前脚刚走，后脚三班新兵就议论开了。因为背对着食堂方向，所以并未看清事情经过。说着说着就集体被孔垄这个狗脑子给带跑偏，整的莫名其妙。就在这帮人商量着，要不要一起跟过去看看究竟啥事时，一班长从远处吹着哨子跑了过来。周凯东离开前，担心新兵蛋子没人看着会不守纪律，特意让他来帮忙盯着。“干什么干什么，谁让你们从旗台上下来的，让特么你们解散了吗，都特么给我站回去！”“一班长，我们到时间了。”孔垄赶紧解释，但一班长听都不听。“少几把在这糊弄我！”“半边脚掌站军姿，立即给我上去！”“我这人可没有你们班长那么好脾气，别让老子重复第二遍！”三班新兵欲哭无泪，这尼玛刚罚站结束，又来？一班长脾气不好是全连出了名的，一句话里全是情绪助词，不带点儿脏字不会说话的那种。就不能换个班长来吗，二班长性格可比他好多了，见谁都笑呵呵的！“站直了！”“身体微微前倾！”“让你身体前倾，你屁股翘特么那么高干什么？”孔垄欲哭无泪，屁股再次挨了一下，来了个梅开二度。他现在已经没心思去管那边到底发生了啥，只求这个脾气暴躁的一班长赶紧走。这家伙不光话说的难听，下手死重死重的，比班长狠多了！......“跑啊，再跑啊？”“你不是能跑吗？”“生瓜蛋子，真以为我们炊事班就不搞体能，啊？”与此同时，垃圾场墙角位置。丁腾飞慌不择路，最终被两三个炊事班老兵追上，按在墙上。这些老兵力气很大，根本不给他反抗机会，不论他如何挣扎都无济于事。陆阳姗姗来迟，连忙冲进去将人扒拉开，把丁腾飞挡在后头。“各位班长，有话好好说，有话好好说，是不是有什么误会？”“误会？”那个叫刘诚的上等兵喘着气，一脸冷笑。“我告诉你，我下午看着你们干活儿，主要就是盯这小子！”“我一早就知道这小子手脚不干净，果不其然还真让我给逮着了！”陆阳还想说点儿什么争取时间，但却被直接粗暴的扒拉到一旁。这时他才发现，自已这体格子跟老兵比起来，差了真不是一星半点儿。部队里，通常只要当个两三年兵，体能就会甩开普通人一大截。堂哥两年义务兵回来这么些年了，引体向上轻轻松松能上十个，吊打一众同龄人。而炊事兵平日里切菜颠勺，干的都是体力活儿，手上力气可不小。据说，演习和野外军事技能比拼时，炊事兵背着大铁锅，提着两桶油照样能健步如飞。尤其是烧完菜后，还得有专人背着特制保温箱，穿越战场将饭菜送往前线，这本事哪是一般战士能比的？陆阳因为底子实在薄弱，到目前为止体能在所有新兵里头 ，只能算是普普通通马马虎虎。尽管有系统在，但成长型系统起步缓慢，走的是稳扎稳打路线，需要一定时间去催化，越到后期成效越显著。但凡陆阳入伍前有个像孔垄这样的体格子，也不至于会被这帮老兵直接无视，粗暴扒拉到一旁！这也更加激发，他必须要在体能上提高突破，成为兵王的决心！“拿过来！”“撒手！”“把手给我撒开！”两个老兵按着丁腾飞，刘诚则上去抢夺他手上的黑色垃圾袋。他相信，这里头鼓囊囊沉甸甸的，肯定是赃物。如果能够人赃并获，那就是捍卫炊事班财产。最次也得是个口头表扬，整不好还能闹个嘉奖呢。但主观上，刘诚并没有想要立功的想法，他下午使劲盯着二人，也是担心丁腾飞会闹出什么幺蛾子。毕竟全连从上到下谁不知道这是个人见人嫌的惹祸精，之前惹出来烂摊子还少吗？也算是瞎猫碰上死耗子，让他给逮个正着！丁腾飞奋力挣扎，甚至张口咬在其中一人的胳膊上。“啊啊啊......操，你是狗啊！”吃痛下，有人松开了手。另一人明显也害怕被咬，主动把手松开。但却也帮助刘诚一起，从丁腾飞手里将那两个大号垃圾袋抢了过来。袋口朝下，哗啦啦的直接将里头东西全部抖落出来。瓜果碎屑，烂菜帮子，包装袋，各种瓶瓶罐罐散落一地。混合着厨余垃圾的气味，实在不大好闻，却并没有发现什么“赃物”？刘诚有点儿懵圈，甚至还蹲在地上用手挑挑拣拣，却依旧一无所获。“什么情况？”“怎么会没有呢？”“刘诚，你搞什么鬼？”“你到底有没有看到他偷东西，别看走眼了！”被老兵这么一挤兑，刘诚脸上顿时有些挂不住了。嘴里嘟嘟囔囔的，说着可能，应该，或许大概一类的话。陆阳见状也终于松了口气，想要带着丁腾飞离开，却再次被阻拦。“等一下！”刘诚站起身，依旧不依不饶的盯着丁腾飞：“既然你没偷东西，我让你站住，如果不是做贼心虚你为什么要跑？”丁腾飞解释：“你追我，我才跑的。”“你不跑，我为什么会追你？”“你不追，我怎么会跑？”“你不跑，我怎么......”刘诚差点儿被绕进去了，立马抬手打住。他心里有七八成底气，丁腾飞肯定是干了什么事。即便是没偷东西，很可能也搞了什么破坏，或是报复性的损毁了什么。所以暂时还不能让他离开，最好是带他回食堂查个清楚，如果没问题再放人也不迟。但陆阳却不能让他们就这么揪着丁腾飞，把人像押犯人那样给带回去，即便有什么情况也得等到班长来了才行！就在陆阳和对方发生言语争执，阻挠他们把人带走时，周凯东终于来了。但他并不是急匆匆跑来，而是寒着脸一步步的从训练场方向走来。带着怒气的周凯东气场还是很强大的，三个炊事兵加在一块都没有他军龄长，立马便不约而同的撒开了丁腾飞。“怎么回事？”周凯东寒着脸走过来，没去看丁腾飞，而是首先质问三个炊事兵。两个一期士官全部看向刘诚，先前他俩也是听到喊有人偷东西，才追出来的。现在啥也没有，甚至可能闹了个乌龙，自然得刘诚这小子来背锅。刘诚还是挺怵周凯东的，只因周凯东太像当初带他的那个严厉班长了。“一排长，我怀疑你的兵，手脚不干净！”“怀疑？”“对！”“有证据吗？”“额，目前没有......”
content_en: "What's going on over there?" "I don't know?" "I think I heard someone shouting to catch the thief?" "Did you hear that wrong? It sounds like digging a ditch to me?" As soon as Zhou Kaidong left, the recruits from the third class started talking.Because his back was toward the cafeteria, he didn't see what happened clearly.As they talked, they were all led astray by Kong Long's stupid brain, which was inexplicable.Just when this group of people were discussing whether they should follow together to see what was going on, a squad leader came running over blowing a whistle from a distance.Before Zhou Kaidong left, he was worried that recruit Danzi would be undisciplined if no one was watching, so he specifically asked him to help keep an eye on him."What are you doing? Who asked you to come down from the flag stand? Did you disband? Come back here!" "Squad leader, it's time." Kong Long explained quickly, but the squad leader didn't listen."You guys are fooling me here!" "Stand on the soles of your feet in a military posture, get up here immediately!" "I'm not as good-tempered as your squad leader, don't let me repeat it a second time!" The recruits in the third squad were about to cry without tears. This guy has just finished standing for punishment, and he's coming again?The squad leader is famous throughout the company for his bad temper. His sentences are full of emotional particles, and he can't speak without using some curse words.Couldn't there be another squad leader? The second squad leader has a much better personality than him. He makes everyone smile when he sees him!"Stand up straight!" "Lean forward slightly!" "Lean forward, why are your butts so high?" Kong Long was about to cry, but he was hit on the butt again, scoring twice.He no longer had the mind to care about what was going on over there. He just wanted the grumpy squad leader to leave quickly.Not only did this guy speak harshly, he also struck a deadly blow, much more ruthless than the squad leader!..."Run, run again?" "Can't you run?" "I really thought our cooking class didn't do physical fitness, huh?" At the same time, there was a corner of the garbage dump.Ding Tengfei panicked and was eventually caught up by two or three veterans of the cooking class and pinned against the wall.These veterans were very strong and did not give him a chance to resist. No matter how hard he struggled, it was of no avail.Lu Yang arrived late and rushed in to pull the man away, blocking Ding Tengfei from behind."Team leaders, please speak up if you have anything to say. Is there any misunderstanding?" "Misunderstanding?" The superior soldier named Liu Cheng gasped with a sneer on his face."Let me tell you, I watched you guys working in the afternoon, mainly to keep an eye on this kid!" "I knew early on that this kid's hands and feet were dirty, and sure enough, he got caught by me!" Lu Yang wanted to say something to buy time, but he was roughly pulled aside.Only then did he realize that compared to the veteran, his body structure was really not that bad.In the army, usually as long as you serve as a soldier for two or three years, your physical fitness will be far behind that of ordinary people.It has been so many years since my cousin returned from his two-year military service. He can easily do ten pull-ups, beating all his peers.On weekdays, cooks cut vegetables and use spoons. They do all physical work, and their hands are quite strong.It is said that during exercises and field military skills competitions, the cooks could still walk as fast as they could while carrying a large iron pot on their backs and two barrels of oil.Especially after cooking, someone has to carry a special insulated box across the battlefield to deliver the food to the front line. How can this ability be compared to that of ordinary soldiers?Because Lu Yang's foundation is really weak, his physical fitness so far is the best among all the recruits, and he can only be regarded as average.Although there is a system, the growth system starts slowly and takes a steady and steady route. It takes a certain amount of time to catalyze, and the results will be more significant in the later stages.If Lu Yang had a physique like Kong Long before joining the army, he wouldn't have been ignored and roughly pulled aside by these veterans!This also further inspired his determination to improve his physical fitness and become the king of soldiers!"Bring it over!" "Let go!" "Get your hands away!" The two veterans held Ding Tengfei down while Liu Cheng went up to snatch the black garbage bag from his hand.He believed that the heavy bulges here must be stolen goods.If one can gain both the stolen goods and others, then it is to protect the property of the cooking class.In the end, it has to be a verbal praise. If it's not done well, you can even get a reward.But subjectively, Liu Cheng had no intention of making meritorious deeds. He stared hard at the two of them in the afternoon because he was worried that Ding Tengfei would cause some trouble.After all, who in the whole company from top to bottom doesn't know that this is a troublemaker whom everyone dislikes? Has he caused a lot of messes before?It can be regarded as a blind cat encountering a dead mouse, let him catch it!Ding Tengfei struggled hard and even bit one of them on the arm."Ahhh...fuck, you're a dog!" After the pain, someone let go of his hand.The other person was obviously afraid of being bitten and took the initiative to release his hand.But he also helped Liu Cheng and snatched the two large garbage bags from Ding Tengfei.With the mouth of the bag facing down, all the contents inside were shaken out with a loud splash.Fruit scraps, rotten vegetables, packaging bags, and various bottles and cans were scattered on the floor.The smell mixed with kitchen waste is really unpleasant, but no "stolen items" were found?Liu Cheng was a little confused. He even squatted on the ground and picked with his hands, but still found nothing."What's going on?" "How come there isn't?" "Liu Cheng, what the hell are you doing?" "Did you see him stealing anything? Don't look away!" Liu Cheng's face suddenly became uneasy after being squeezed by the veteran.He was mumbling words like maybe, should, maybe probably.Lu Yang finally breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this, and wanted to leave with Ding Tengfei, but was blocked again."Wait a minute!" Liu Cheng stood up and still stared at Ding Tengfei relentlessly: "Since you didn't steal anything, I told you to stop. Why did you run if you weren't guilty of thief?" Ding Tengfei explained: "You chased me, so I ran." "Why did I chase you if you didn't run?" "How could I run if you didn't chase?" "If you didn't run, how could I..." Liu Cheng was almost surrounded, and he immediately raised his hand to stop.He was 70% to 80% confident that Ding Tengfei must have done something.Even if he didn't steal anything, he probably did some damage or damaged something in retaliation.So we can't let him leave for the time being. It's best to take him back to the canteen to check clearly. If there is no problem, it won't be too late to let him go.But Lu Yang couldn't let them just grab Ding Tengfei and take him back like a prisoner. Even if there was any situation, he had to wait until the squad leader came!Just when Lu Yang had a verbal argument with the other party and prevented them from taking the person away, Zhou Kaidong finally arrived.But he didn't come in a hurry, but walked step by step from the direction of the training ground with a cold face.The angry Zhou Kaidong still had a strong aura. The three cooks together were not as senior as him, so they immediately dismissed Ding Tengfei in unison."What's going on?" Zhou Kaidong walked over with a cold face. He didn't look at Ding Tengfei, but first asked the three cooking soldiers.The two first-term sergeants all looked at Liu Cheng. They had chased him out after hearing someone shouting that someone was stealing something.Now there is nothing, and it may even be an own mistake. Naturally, Liu Cheng will take the blame.Liu Cheng was still quite afraid of Zhou Kaidong, just because Zhou Kaidong looked so much like the strict monitor who took him there."First Platoon Commander, I suspect that your soldiers have dirty hands and feet!" "Suspicion?" "Yes!" "Is there any evidence?" "Well, there is none at the moment..."
